title: games/<slug>/manifest.json
description: Everything the statistics (bgai/summary) and the dashboard need to know about a game that the engine cannot tell them. Checked by tools/check_repo.py. Texts shown to readers are objects {language code: text} with at least 'en'.

text.description: A text per language code, e.g. {"en": "Dwellers", "cs": "Obyvatelé"}.

slug.description: Folder name under games/, lowercase with underscores.

publisher.description: Publisher, shown on the game page and used in RIGHTS.md.

designer.description: Designer(s), shown on the game page.

edition.description: Exactly what is modelled: base game, which expansions, deck size. Shown to readers.

players.description: Player counts the engine supports (all are checked by bgai.checks).

rights.description: Path of the rights file inside the game folder (RIGHTS.md).

theme.description: Game colour on the dashboard: links, the plan block and the bars a finding is about. Pick a dark, muted colour (white text must read on it).

intro.description: Two or three plain sentences: how the game is played and what decides it. First thing a reader sees.

name_local.description: Optional official title per language when it differs (shown as "Name (local title)" in that language only).

items_note.description: Optional note next to the item count on the items tab, e.g. how the total is made up.

terms.description: Per language, the game's own words the dashboard uses in its sentences.

item.description: One scored thing: card, bird, tile.

board.description: What a player builds and is scored: forest, player mat.

archetype.description: Name of the board type label (see archetype): forest type, main habitat.

round.description: The unit of game length in the length section.

tags.description: Tag names the engine writes into tableau rows (tags: {name: value}); the label is the column title. Tag values are translated in i18n/<lang>.json under tags.<name>.

archetype.description: How a whole board gets one type label (bgai.summary.board_archetypes): the most frequent value of a tag across its items.

tag.description: The tableau tag whose most frequent value names the type.

min_share.description: Below this share of the board the type is MIXED.

extra_counts.description: Extra type values counted from a seat column, e.g. {"SAPLING": "saplings"} counts x_saplings as cards of type SAPLING.

rule.description: The rule in one plain sentence, shown under the chart.

score_categories.description: Keys of breakdowns(); their sum must equal scores(). Order = display order.

seat_extras.description: Keys of seat_extra() (recorded as x_<key> columns) shown in the play-style tables.

top_decision.description: The decision kind of a player's main turn choice (counted in 'What the AI does on its turn').

actions.description: Answers of top_decision -> label. Answers not listed are not shown.

fate.description: What happens to physical cards: group name -> action names that end a card that way. The FIRST group is 'played'; with two or more groups the LAST is compared with playing (pay_vs_play). 'left_in_hand' is added automatically.

fate_labels.description: Labels for the fate groups plus left_in_hand.

optional_decisions.description: A yes/no decision for optional powers; the dashboard shows how often the AI uses each kind.

group_pattern.description: Regex on the decision's 'what' field; group 1 is the kind shown.

show.description: false for fixed-length games: hides the game-length section.

item_attributes.description: Catalog item fields shown on item pages and usable as filters.

featured.description: Per player count (string), which experiments the dashboard shows: main (required), compare (an earlier AI's mirror), versus (head-to-head).

ai_status.description: Set while a model is being trained, so a game without experiments shows 'the AI is still learning' instead of 'engine ready, AI not trained yet'. Remove it when the first experiment is published.

languages.description: Languages with complete texts (intro, terms, labels, i18n files, notes).
